name: Safari
capability: Schema evolution under a live write stream
hook: A watering-hole database that never stops changing, eight schema changes you apply on purpose, and a verifier that tells you whether your replica kept up.
status: v0.1, runnable offline; run once against an Artie pipeline to Snowflake on 2026-10-21 (docs/artie-run.md)
recording_note: compose up, the stream, the eight events, verify passing after each, then the three queries on the replica. Real output, not mocked.
schema_note: Generated from information_schema at the end of the sequence by pg/schema_svg.py.
run_note: The third command keeps writing until you stop it; run it in its own terminal. The fourth applies the eight events, waiting for the replica to catch up where an event needs it, then checks the replica. To check after each event, run events/apply.sh N and python3 verify.py --wait 120 for N from 1 to 8.
events_note: Each event file says what Postgres emits, what Artie documents, and what the destination should look like. What a native Postgres subscriber actually did, including the run where it was given no DDL and stalled, is in

events.title: Weigh-in
events.ddl: ALTER TABLE animals ADD COLUMN weight_kg numeric(6,2)
events.tests: column appears on the replica after the next row change; verify passes

events.title: A pangolin is sighted
events.tests: a row with the new label replicates once the replica's enum has it

events.title: The herd outgrows int
events.ddl: ALTER TABLE animals ALTER COLUMN animal_id TYPE bigint (and observations)
events.tests: animal 3000000001 lands; column types match on both sides

events.title: The collars come online
events.tests: replica needs the table created and the subscription refreshed; the refresh copies the existing rows

events.title: The naming committee
events.ddl: ALTER TABLE animals RENAME COLUMN name TO display_name
events.tests: rows before and after the rename carry different column names; the replica must accept both until it has caught up, or it stops for good

events.title: Rangers file structured reports
events.ddl: ALTER TABLE observations ADD COLUMN field_report jsonb
events.tests: JSON round-trips; the field-report query returns rows

events.title: Survey adds elevation
events.ddl: ALTER TABLE watering_holes ADD COLUMN elevation_m int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
events.tests: only the 12 updated rows cross the wire; the backfill of defaults does not

events.title: Status moves to the collars
events.ddl: ALTER TABLE animals DROP COLUMN status
events.tests: writer stops sending status; replica must relax the NOT NULL first and drop the column only after catching up
